title: California Online Privacy Protection Act (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 22575-22579)
version_label: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 22575-22579, as published by the California Legislature (leginfo); 22575 amended by Stats. 2013, Ch. 390 (AB 370), effective 1 January 2014
license_note: Statutory text of five short sections. The California Legislature's Privacy and Conditions of Use Policy says some information on its site may be protected by copyright and that permission to use that material must be obtained from the Assembly, the Senate or the Legislative Counsel Bureau. Statutory text is law; see the note on the Sources page.
